news.title: Arvex To Replace Kim Hin Joo On Bursa ACE Market From Sept 11

recent_en: ARVEX replaced Kim Hin Joo on the Bursa ACE Market on 11 September 2026, followed by several OTHERS announcements in September. In early October, there was a boardroom change with Mr Yap Shuh Jian stepping down; at end-September, substantial shareholder Pang Kim Hin and Kim Hin International Pte. Ltd. reported changes in their interests. The company released its consolidated quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 26 November.
notable_en: ARVEX replaced Kim Hin Joo on the Bursa ACE Market on 11 September 2026.
On 6 October 2026, Mr Yap Shuh Jian stepped down from the board.
On 29 September 2026, substantial shareholder Pang Kim Hin and Kim Hin International Pte. Ltd. reported changes in their interests.
